description: Daily staff performance reporting & Kanban workflow (Plan, Doing, Finish) for 85 staff members with Google Sheets export simulation, charts, analytics, and personal performance summaries.
layouts: Kanban Board View (Plan, Doing, Finish) with drag-drop / status switcher
Staff Directory (85 members) with individual profile performance drill-down
Analytics & Charts View (Daily completion rate, category distribution, productivity score)
Admin Management & Google Sheets Sync modal/tab

accessibility.data_testid: mandatory on all buttons, links, inputs, and key indicators

image_urls.description: Diverse group of professionals standing together indoors

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a robust React application in /app/frontend with Tailwind CSS and Lucide icons.
No login required (Direct Dashboard Demo mode with active role switcher: Staff vs Admin).
Include simulated database of 85 staff members with avatars, departments, and daily metrics.
Implement Kanban Workflow with Plan (Blue), Doing (Amber), and Finish (Emerald) columns and task creation/editing modal (target, priority, due date, notes, proof link).
Add Analytics & Charts using Recharts showing workflow percentages, daily completion trends, and departmental breakdown.
Add Google Sheets Sync simulation button with status indicator and export options.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes for testing.
